settings.repere: Titre H2 · What comes in the teeth whitening kit?
settings.text: What comes in the teeth whitening kit?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The kit includes a free at-home impressi
settings.text: The kit includes a free at-home impression kit, an impression guide, custom whitening trays, a storage container, and one set of teeth whitening gel.

settings.repere: Titre H2 · How does the whitening kit work?
settings.text: How does the whitening kit work?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · First, you take your impressions at home
settings.text: First, you take your impressions at home so your custom trays can be made, send them back, and in as little as two weeks your custom trays will be mailed to you. Once your trays have arrived, apply the recommended amount of whitening gel into the tray channels, insert the trays, and whiten as directed.

settings.repere: Titre H2 · How is this different from buying whiten
settings.text: How is this different from buying whitening gel alone?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The kit includes both the gel and the cu
settings.text: The kit includes both the gel and the custom trays needed to use it properly. The trays are designed with spacing channels to hold the whitening gel in place for better coverage.

settings.repere: Titre H2 · How long do I wear the trays?
settings.text: How long do I wear the trays?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Wear the trays for 10 minutes per day wh
settings.text: Wear the trays for 10 minutes per day when using the whitening gel. Do not exceed 10 minutes per day, and avoid eating or drinking while whitening. After completing your initial 7–14 day treatment, use once or twice a month to maintain results. Avoid hot water and bleach-based products that could damage the tray material.

settings.repere: Titre H2 · Are the trays reusable?
Paragraphe · Yes. Your custom trays are reusable. Aft
settings.text: Yes. Your custom trays are reusable. After each session, rinse your mouth and trays with cool water, let the trays dry, and store them in the included case. Once you run out of gel, you can continue using the trays with Revived Smiles whitening gel refills.

settings.repere: Titre H2 · What is the difference between custom wh
settings.text: What is the difference between custom whitening trays and generic whitening trays?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Custom whitening trays are made from you
settings.text: Custom whitening trays are made from your impressions, so they fit your teeth more closely. Generic trays are one-size-fits-all, which can make it harder for the gel to stay evenly placed. A custom fit helps keep the whitening gel in the right areas for more even coverage and a more comfortable whitening experience.
